review:
Bitcoin Million is a 100-line classic slot that swaps traditional fruit icons for crypto-themed symbols. Underneath, it's a familiar layout with wilds and scatters.

Expanding wilds can fill entire reels to complete wins across many lines, and an optional card gamble round is available after base-game wins. There's no complex bonus round, so most of the action comes from line hits and expanding wilds. BGaming rates it medium-high volatility with a 3,000x maximum, and the RTP of 97.1% is high. It's one of BGaming's crypto-era designs and a good fit for players who like simple line slots with a modern theme.
pros: Excellent 97.10% RTP – among the highest published
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
